scientific_integrity: An analytic Fourier/Taylor/dyadic argument establishes the theorem; 38 numerical checks are consistency checks only. Originality is a best-knowledge comparison of accessible relevant primary texts, not independently certified priority.
scientific_limitations: Free one-dimensional fractional Schrödinger propagation from a fixed even Gaussian momentum packet at each fixed positive time; no extension to nonlinear gain, scattering barriers, higher dimensions or uniform time endpoints.
title: Interference fringes at the Gaussian–algebraic crossover of fractional quantum packets
